title: Failure of coefficient separation
statement: Let $n$, $\ell$, and $m$ be nonnegative integers. The separation failure set consists of the sequences of $m$ points of $\mathbb F_2^n$ for which the sample evaluations do not determine every low-degree coefficient array uniquely.
caveat: The definition of the evaluation map and coefficient arrays is not included in the supplied snippet.
